caption: Some days after work, I just don’t have the time or energy to make a homemade meal—but I still want my husband and me to eat something warm, nourishing, and satisfying. That’s why I keep Oma Bone Broth Seaweed Soup in the pantry for busy days. 🤍 The ingredients are clean, and honestly, it tastes just like homemade miyeok guk. All you do is: • Add 1 packet + 1 cup of water • Toss in any extras you like (I added ½ block of silken tofu today!) • Serve over a bowl of warm rice 🍚 It’s such an easy, comforting meal, especially with a side of kimchi. Quick, nutritious, and perfect for those hectic working mom evenings. 💚 Link in bio under my favorites! #WorkingMom #EasyDinner #KoreanFood #MiyeokGuk #BusyMomMeals
